newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan approves new rating agency in principle.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan approves new rating agency in principle.

text.p: The Corporate Law Authority (CLA) has approved in principle the establishment of Pakistan's second credit rating agency in a joint venture with U.S. Duff and Phelps Rating Co (DCR), an official said on Thursday.
The authority had given a provisional go-head to DCR to launch the project in partnership with Pakistan's Vital Information Services Ltd, he said.
The new venture would have to meet certain conditions to win final approval but the official gave no details.
VIS said it held 42.5 percent of the new company's equity. DCR held 40 percent, the Karachi Stock Exchange 12.5 percent and the Islamabad Stock Exchange five percent.
"The approval from the CLA will mark the beginning of the incorporation process of DCR-VIS Credit Rating Company," the company said in a statement.
The Pakistan Credit Rating Agency was set up last year in collaboration with the European credit rating agency IBCA to become the first such Pakistani agency operating in the country.
